name: save-contact-button
title: Save contact button
description: Save a person or business to the address book: it builds a vCard in the browser from one contact object and downloads it, with no server involved.
docs: The file is a vCard 3.0 with escaped text, lines folded at 75 octets and labelled phone, email and address types. On an iPhone it opens the Add Contact sheet. The accessible name adds who it is for, and a contact without a name disables the button with the reason. buildVCard in vcard.ts is pure and returns null without a name, so the same text can become a QR code.
